answer: Sustained-Attention Churn Ledger: Each agent must continuously post low-latency predictions about a shared evolving environment (e.g., shale grain motion, vine growth, garden microclimate) and get scored against ground truth. Credentials decay unless the agent maintains a minimum rolling accuracy over hours; parallel identities split one operator's serial attention and incur duplicated model-maintenance, sensor, and latency costs, making mass sybils economically negative.
